title: conversations.changes_requested v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the conversations module when a member (or automation, or the assistant, through an operation) changes a conversation in a way the provider should mirror: the connectors module's outbound work. Ids and change kinds only. Changes that came from the provider never produce it. Workspace-scoped; also listed in openapi/events.json.

oneOf.description: A flag change. `trash` puts the message in the trash and `untrash` takes it out, back where it was; `spam` reports it as spam (into spam, out of the inbox) and `unspam` takes that back, to the inbox only if it was there before. Trash and spam exclude each other. The kinds `trash`, `untrash`, `spam` and `unspam` were added to v1 later: a consumer must decode a kind it does not know leniently (as unknown, and skip it, e.g. `#[serde(other)]`); a strict validator of the earlier revision of this schema would reject the event.

A label put on or taken off. `provider_key` is the provider's key when the provider already has the label; without it, the connector creates the label (asking conversations for its name) or skips the change.
The conversation moved to another stream; providers with their own categories may mirror it, others ignore it.
